configSchema.name: dsAuthServer
configSchema.description: DocuSign OAuth authorization server host, e.g. account.docusign.com or account-d.docusign.com

configSchema.name: dsBaseUri
configSchema.description: DocuSign API base URI for this account, e.g. https://na3.docusign.net

configSchema.name: dsAccountId
configSchema.description: DocuSign account id to create envelopes under

configSchema.name: templateId
configSchema.description: DocuSign template id to use for the envelope

configSchema.name: signerRoleName
configSchema.description: Template role name for the signer recipient

configSchema.name: ccRoleName
configSchema.description: Template role name for the optional cc recipient

configSchema.name: fieldMappings
configSchema.description: Map a Terros account field (CF.* or a dotted path like resident.email) to a DocuSign target: signer.email, signer.name, cc.email, cc.name, or a template tab Data Label

authSchema.dsPrivateKey: DocuSign RSA private key (PEM) for JWT signing
